title: 📥 Import / Export — all editable settings
help: Provides a clean round-trip between the live tool and Excel so a configuration can be saved, shared, version-controlled or prepared offline by a colleague, then loaded back exactly.
= automation, glass ceiling, y1/y2/y3 ramp, horizon, setup (×4), token cost, tokens/artifact, infra, working days, classic saving, industry
Export → edit in Excel → import reproduces the identical model output (same ROI, FTE, costs).
On import, each value is checked: e.g. automation potential is clamped to [10, 80], ramps to their slider bounds, FTE to ≥ 0. Anything adjusted is listed in the import report.
ships with Excel data-validation (dropdowns and min/max) baked into the cells, so values are constrained at entry time. Use it as the starting point for offline configuration.

texts.saveHtml: Download the entire application as a single standalone HTML file, frozen at its current configuration — all sliders, team, scope, regulatory selection, personas, coefficients, readiness answers and client tracker data. Opening the downloaded file lands you exactly where you left off. Fully offline, no server needed.
texts.saveJsonTitle: 💾 Save the case as a snapshot file (.json)
texts.saveJson: Available now: the whole case in the legacy snapshot format (every registry key), loadable by this build. Open one with the button below — the case you had stays one Ctrl+Z away.
texts.settingsIntro: Export every editable parameter of this tool to an Excel workbook, edit it offline, and re-import it to restore the exact configuration. The workbook structure is round-trippable and matches the parameter template (with field constraints) provided alongside the app.
texts.exportText: Generates AgentCase_Parameters.xlsx capturing the current state of all tabs: global parameters, phase scope, location strategy, the full Rate Card matrix and the input team composition.
texts.importText: Load a previously exported (or template-based) .xlsx. Values are validated against the same constraints as the UI; out-of-range values are clamped and reported. All tabs refresh automatically.
texts.later: Excel import and export are available in a later release (Phase 6 of the migration, ExcelJS loaded on demand). Until then, use the JSON snapshot on the Save tab: it carries the same settings.
texts.managerText: The named snapshot library stored inside the file (capture, activate, delete, promote to baseline) and the golden-case comparison are available in a later release. Until then, save and open snapshot files; every change of the case is undoable and the autosave keeps a rolling copy (see Sessions).
